subcommands.name: get-media
subcommands.description: Use this API to retrieve media content from a Kinesis video stream.

options.name: --stream-name
options.description: The Kinesis video stream name from where you want to get the media content. If you don't specify the streamName, you must specify the streamARN

options.name: --stream-arn
options.description: The ARN of the stream from where you want to get the media content. If you don't specify the streamARN, you must specify the streamName

options.name: --start-selector
options.description: Identifies the starting chunk to get from the specified stream

options.name: outfile
options.description: Filename where the content will be saved
